subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises 'wh' at the beginning of words (wh-en, wh-y, wh-at)

show.line: When, why, what, where, who. Question words start the same way! Two letters, one sound. Wuh!

rounds.prompt: Tap the word that starts like when.
Which two letters start the word where?
rounds.praise: Yes! Those two letters start where.

rounds.story: Mama asks, where is your shoe? Thabo looks. It is under the bed. Which question word did Mama use?

hints: Question words start with the same two letters. When, why, what.
Look at the first two letters of the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this question word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That word is what. What, not when.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. What. What is your name?

parent_line: Can read question words that start with wh: when, why, what, where, who.
